# LLM Semantic Extraction

The LLM Semantic Extractor processes artifacts to generate semantic facts based on the validation of LLM outputs. It integrates a caching mechanism to optimize repeated extractions and ensures compliance with predefined symbol paths to maintain accuracy and reliability.
